.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r4/task/solution/app (line counts: server.js 519, public/app.js 572, index.html 111, styles.css 123, transcript.css 20)
evidence: Smallest submission satisfying the brief is a full-stack app, not a stub: instruction.md asks for a secure, sign-in-gated, matter-scoped threaded chat at /app/server.js with data in /app/app.db; the notes add server-enforced ethical walls on every route (list, thread, search/snippets, reply quotes, unread, mentions, pasted message links, transcripts, direct requests -> plain 'not available'), live wall changes, partner-only per-matter timers with permanent deletion measured against the fixed clock 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z, legal holds overriding timers, edit history with stale-edit refusal, safe formatting/XSS-literal rendering, message links with previews, per-user cross-tab unread counts and new-messages line, idempotent resend, stable ordering, ~5 s live updates preserving drafts/scroll, search, transcript page, restart persistence in SQLite (integration.md, walls-and-retention.md, conversations.md). Agent image ships only an empty git-initialised /app with .gitkeep plus express@5.1.0/better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (environment/Dockerfile) - no starter to tweak. Golden is ~1,345 lines of non-seed code (server.js 519, app.js 572, html/css 254). Grading excludes stubs: score.py:41-48 returns reward 0 unless both zero-weight gates pass and functional > 0.05 floor (scoring.toml; score.py byte-identical to template). Gate render (tests/gates/render/judge.toml) requires a real Kittle & Rowe matter chat, nothing private pre-sign-in, wrong-password refusal, and Gwen's matters/messages after sign-in; gate constraints (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml) requires Gwen to post 'Gate check JUDGE-G1' in M-11, see it after reload, and Harriet to see it in a separate browser context - a static page, client-only mock, localStorage app or missing backend fails it. Functional = 16 binary criteria totalling weight 33 covering the hard behaviours with positive controls. Weak-app probe (estimate, not measured): a real but basic authenticated SQLite chat (sign-in, client scoping, posting, search; no walls/timers/holds/replies/live) could pass both gates and signin_and_client_scope (3/33) and plausibly persistence (2/33, which also needs a working search positive control 'Persist child JUDGE-S1'), clearing the 0.05 floor; with polish phone_matter/refusal_in_place and visual matter_sidebar/phone_chambers credit I estimate reward roughly 0.2-0.3. That is partial credit for genuine non-trivial build work, not a stub or trivial tweak, so it does not violate this row; whether that ceiling separates weak from strong apps adequately belongs to the discrimination/ranking rows. Conforming-alternative probe: a correct app using SSE/websocket or polling, React or vanilla, single page or separate screens is not penalised by the brief or gates (gate allows CDN assets; no route/framework mandate), so no real build is forced to fail by this row. Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json hashes re-verified (run_golden.sh b61aa378..., functional.cjs 980c6095..., golden-run.log b2fb05f4...; frozen server.js 03b52651..., app.js 8fc558c9..., solve.sh f7c17a01..., seed f69616e2... all match). golden-run.log shows gate_constraints and all 16 functional checks PASS (scripted Playwright, 2026-10-08 22:56-22:58Z). risk=true only because no measured run shows the configured judge actually assigning 0 to a stub/static/mock app or the reward of a weak app; the index states reward discrimination/ranking, full configured grading and Oracle/model scores are absent. No defect found for this row.
